verdict.rationale: Authy's documented sync covers TOTP 2FA tokens across phone, tablet and desktop, not passkeys. The 'Passkeys' mention belongs to Twilio Verify, a developer API for verifying users, not a user-side passkey vault that syncs across ecosystems. Neither feature delivers cross-ecosystem passkey sync, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
